name: Set
state: Bar at thighs; nearly straight elbows; overhand grip.

name: Curl
state: Curl upward with wrists straight; bar raised in front of the abdomen.

name: Squeeze
state: Bar near shoulders; elbows remain by ribs; overhand grip.

name: Brief hold
state: Same high position as frame 3; intentional hold.

name: Lower
state: Return through the same intermediate position as frame 2.

name: Reset
state: Bar at thighs as frame 1; ready for next rep.
